message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: illegal hunting of protected wildlife (black water chicken) which is a "三有" animal (protected). Selling them. This constitutes illegal hunting, illegal sale of protected wildlife. Under Chinese law, crimes: "非法狩猎、捕捉、收购、运输、出售国家重点保护野生动物罪" (illegal hunting, catching, buying, transporting, selling protected wildlife). Also possibly "非法买卖、利用国家重点保护野生动物罪". The specific article: Criminal Law Article 341 (illegal hunting, killing, etc). Also Article 338? Actually Chinese Criminal Law: Article 341: "非法猎捕、杀害国家重点保护的野生动物或者非法收购、运输、出售国家重点保护的野生动物的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" So the crime is "非法猎捕、收购、运输、出售国家重点保护野生动物罪". The fact includes illegal hunting and selling. So one crime covers both. Could also be "非法买卖国家重点保护野生动物罪". But they are same. Usually the charge is "非法猎捕、收购、运输、出售国家重点保护野生动物罪". So answer: [罪名]非法猎捕、收购、运输、出售国家重点保护野生动物罪<eoa>
